display.label: Azure Function App Function
display.description: Manages an individual function within an Azure Function App with code files, triggers, and bindings

resource.key_description: The unique name for the function within the Function App. Serves as the map key.

sections.label: Basic Configuration
sections.description: Core function identification and runtime settings.

fields.label: Function Name
fields.description: The name of the function. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

fields.label: Function App ID
fields.description: The ID of the Function App in which this function should reside.

fields.label: Language
fields.description: The language the Function is written in.

sections.label: Function Bindings & Triggers
sections.description: Define triggers, inputs, and outputs via JSON configuration.

fields.label: Configuration JSON
fields.description: The config for this Function in JSON format (function.json), specifying bindings, triggers, and return directives.

sections.label: Source Code Files
sections.description: Source code files deployed to the function.

fields.label: Source Files
fields.description: List of source code files uploaded for this function.

fields.label: File Name
fields.description: The filename of the source file (e.g. run.csx, index.js, __init__.py).

fields.label: File Content
fields.description: The actual source code content of the file.

sections.label: Testing
sections.description: Test data and portal execution parameters.

fields.label: Test Data (JSON)
fields.description: Optional test data in JSON format used for testing the function in the Azure portal.
